The '''Vorusku system''' lay within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained the [[Waterworld/Legends|water planet]] [[Vorusku]]. [[Standard century/Legends|Centuries]] before [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Kina Ha]] temporarily resided on Vorusku. Following the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], the Vorusku [[Crime lord/Legends|crimelord]] [[Jalla Spree]] supplied the [[Blue Star Pirates]] with advanced weaponry.

==Description==
The Vorusku system was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Juris sector/Legends|Juris sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Waterworld/Legends|water planet]] [[Vorusku]].<ref name="Invasion" />

==History==
[[Standard century/Legends|Centuries]] before [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Vorusku date">In ''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]'', [[Kina Ha]] states that, [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] before the events of the novel, she had a [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] depicting the creation of a [[Kamino/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Army/Legends|army]] for the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. ''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]'' states Ha had that vision while living on [[Vorusku]], which means she lived on that [[Planet/Legends|planet]] centuries before the events of ''Imperial Commando: 501st'', which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> Vorusku served as residence for the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Kina Ha]]. During Ha's stay there, she experienced a [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] of the future in which<ref name="GATORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> an [[Army/Legends|army]] of [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] would be created for the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] on Ha's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref> The vision haunted the Jedi, causing her to return to Kamino.<ref name="GATORW" />

Following the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]<ref name="Invasion" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the Vorusku [[Crime lord/Legends|crimelord]] [[Jalla Spree]] began to supply the [[Blue Star Pirates]] with advanced weaponry. One of the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], who was in a hidden cove on a [[Unidentified jungle planet (Blue Star Pirates)|jungle planet]] around that [[Time/Legends|time]], had a [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]] originating from the [[Hyperdrive Cantina]] on Vorusku.<ref name="Invasion" />

{{RPGseed}}
A group of individuals tasked by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Office of the Supreme Chancellor]] to find out the Blue Star Pirates' supplier followed a lead to Vorusku and eventually discovered Spree's role in supplying the pirates.<ref name="Invasion" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Vorusku system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed it in grid square P-17.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
